facts.fact: Seychelles Nation reports the government launched a revamped gov.sc, the official Government Portal, designed to give access to services and information.
The Government of Seychelles' monServis portal lets users access, communicate and transact with government services online through listed eServices.
The monServis portal carries eServices from multiple providers, with individuals signing in with SeyID and organisations onboarding through Biz Auth, per the Government of Seychelles.

facts.fact: The government told the World Bank's GovTech survey (2025 round) that Seychelles has an online public service portal, the eservice.egov.sc E-Services Gateway, rated transactional (level 3 or 4); the line gives no other year, so the round's year is used.

facts.fact: State House reports Vice-President Pillay launched the revamped government portal egov.sc on 22 June 2026, themed on accessing government services in one click.

DICT announced government services now accessible online, including the Mon Servis catalogue, CertExpress for requesting and paying for birth and marriage certificates, and online driving-licence renewal; some services are already available.
Mon Servis is described as a catalogue of all online services the government provides, with a SeyID required to access them, covering licences and certificates.
